units.source_text: 婚后三天，源氏夜夜伴三公主宿。

en.t: For the three days after the wedding, Genji spent every night sleeping beside the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 紫姬多年以来不曾尝过独眠滋味，如今虽然竭力忍受，还是不胜孤寂之感。

en.t: For many years Lady Murasaki had never known what it was to sleep alone, and now, though she tried hard to endure it, she could not bear the feeling of loneliness.

units.source_text: 她越发殷勤地替源氏出门穿的衣服多加熏香。

en.t: With even greater care, she added extra incense to the clothes Genji would wear when he went out.

units.source_text: 那茫然若失的神情，非常可怜而又美丽。

en.t: Her dazed, bereft expression was deeply pitiable and beautiful at the same time.

units.source_text: 源氏想道：“我有了这个人，无论发生何事，岂有再娶一人之理。

en.t: Genji thought, “Since I have this woman, no matter what happens, how could there be any reason for me to take another wife?

units.source_text: 都因我自己性情轻佻，意志薄弱，行事疏忽，以致造成了这个局面。

en.t: It is all because my own nature is frivolous, my will is weak, and I have acted carelessly that this situation has come about.

units.source_text: 夕雾年纪虽轻，却对爱妻十分忠贞，所以朱雀院没看中他。”

en.t: Though Yugiri is young, he is utterly faithful to his beloved wife, and that is why the Suzaku Emperor did not choose him.”

units.source_text: 他自知薄幸，沉思细想，泪盈于睫，对紫姬言道：“今夜我于理不得不去，请你容许。

en.t: Knowing his own inconstancy, he thought deeply, with tears brimming on his lashes, and said to Lady Murasaki, “Tonight, by all propriety, I must go; please allow it.

units.source_text: 今后若再离开你时，我自己也不能容许了。

en.t: If I ever leave you again after this, I myself will not be able to forgive it.

units.source_text: 不过朱雀院倘知道了，不知作何感想。……”

en.t: But if the Suzaku Emperor were to learn of it, I do not know what he would think. …”

units.source_text: 他左右为难，心绪缭乱，样子十分痛苦。

en.t: Caught between two sides, his mind in turmoil, he looked terribly distressed.

units.source_text: 紫姬微微一笑，答道：“你自己心中都没有定见，叫我根据什么理由来做决定呢？”

en.t: Lady Murasaki smiled faintly and replied, “When you yourself have no settled resolve in your heart, on what grounds am I supposed to make a decision?”

units.source_text: 这分明表示他的话毫不足道，竟使得源氏不胜羞耻，手支着颐靠在那里，默不作声。

en.t: This plainly showed that she thought his words hardly worth considering, and Genji, overcome with shame, leaned there with his chin propped on his hand and said nothing.
